name: Source-anchored Gaussian rank copula with feasibility repair
primary_law: Within each sex, generate conditional Gaussian FVC rank scores from normal FEV1 midranks, then assign the sorted FVC column by those scores. Enforce FEV1 <= FVC by a deterministic eligible-row priority assignment.
latent_correlation: For each sex, rho = log(1 + r*CV_FEV1*CV_FVC) / sqrt(log(1+CV_FEV1^2)*log(1+CV_FVC^2)), using the source moments and r=0.96.
constraint_rule: Visit FVC values in ascending order. Among unassigned FEV1 rows not exceeding the current FVC, choose the row with the earliest proposed FVC rank; break ties by row index.
infeasible_marginals_rule: If any ascending FEV1 exceeds the correspondingly ranked FVC, no fully feasible permutation exists. Return the identity permutation for that sex, exposing the incompatibility rather than changing either column.
